items.learningObjective: The two callers need a named set of operations, while only one may change assignment. A capability contract can expose that distinction without making storage fields part of either caller’s API.

items.nearestAlternative: Give the console a mutable BatteryRecord and let it update the aircraftId field for either workflow.
